note: Live-session recording of the SharePoint episode screens (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded. Set MG_TENANT, MG_UPN_DOMAIN and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID in the environment before queueing (never in a file). Sign-ins are device-code, done by the owner. Episodes 1-9 chain: set MG_KEEP_CHAIN=1 while recording them in order so teardown keeps what the next episode uses; unset it for a full clean-up. Needs the SharePoint Administrator role for labadmin.
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
if ((@(Get-PnPSiteScript).Count -ge 95) -or (@(Get-PnPSiteDesign).Count -ge 95)) { throw 'Too many site scripts or site templates in the tenant (limit 100)' }
Get-PnPSiteDesign | Where-Object Title -eq 'Contoso Purchasing' | ForEach-Object { Remove-PnPSiteDesign -Identity $_.Id -Force }
Get-PnPSiteScript | Where-Object Title -like 'Contoso Purchasing - *' | ForEach-Object { Remove-PnPSiteScript -Identity $_.Id -Force }

screens.name: apply-run
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
screens.note: Device-code sign-ins (admin, then site) happen off camera. If the Template run block is empty, run -RunReport instead and capture that. Any Failure is recorded as is.

screens.name: site-settings
steps: Open the Contoso Purchasing site home
Hold on the compact header and open the mega menu: 'How to buy' and 'FAQ'
Scroll to the footer: link 'Purchasing policy'
Optional second capture: Settings > Site information > View all site settings > Regional settings (locale Portuguese (Portugal), time zone GMT, 24-hour)
mask: tenant host in the address bar (pipeline/mask.js)
account avatar and display name in the top bar

screens.name: home-page
steps: Show the two text columns, the News web part with 'New approval limits from January' and the 'Purchasing FAQ' list web part with the FAQ items
If the FAQ list web part renders empty, open it, select the list, and record what happens
mask: tenant host in the address bar (pipeline/mask.js)
account avatar and display name in the top bar
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }

foreach ($q in 'Who approves a request above 1,000 EUR?','How do I order from a new supplier?','Where do I find the approved supplier list?') { Add-PnPListItem -List 'Purchasing FAQ' -Values @{ Title = $q } | Out-Null }
